boundary: Actual existing legacy records/audio copied into a private isolated profile. Current AppModel startup, SQLite migration, search, edit/quit flush and restart run with native services disabled. Original files are not passed to AppModel. No GUI/native app launch, permissions, Keychain, microphone, playback, models, provider requests, original-profile upgrade or abrupt-crash/device acceptance. Private test profile and its source-hash snapshot were removed after verified success; this is ordinary file removal, not secure erasure.
